event_types.name: On Save
event_types.description: Triggered when a record is saved. Most common event type.
event_types.notes: Runs after onChange and onInit. Can modify field values before persistence. Best for derivations that should happen at save time.
tips: Use for field derivations that depend on multiple fields
Runs on both new records and updates

event_types.name: On Change
event_types.description: Triggered when a specific field value changes in the UI.
event_types.notes: Runs in real-time as user edits. Good for cascading derivations and immediate field updates.
tips: Use for real-time cascading (field A changes -> field B updates)
Only triggers when the specific monitored field changes

event_types.name: On Initialize
event_types.description: Triggered when a new record is created (before user fills data).
event_types.notes: Runs only on new records, not edits. Good for setting default values.
tips: Use for default values on new records
Does NOT run when editing existing records
Runs before the user sees the form

event_types.name: Validate
event_types.description: Triggered after save is submitted but before commit. Used for validation only.
event_types.notes: Can raise error messages to block the save if validation fails. Cannot modify field values.
tips: Can block save with error messages
Cannot modify field values, only validate
